description.en: The driver channel ID. Call the [QueryEdgeInstanceChannel](~~162253~~) API to obtain it.

description.zh:
驱动ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**驱动管理**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标驱动名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The driver ID. In the **Driver Management** page of the [Edge Computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover your mouse over the target driver name to obtain the ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~) API to retrieve it.

description.zh:
边缘实例的ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The ID of the edge instance. In the **Edge Instances** page of the [Edge Computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover your mouse over the target edge instance name to obtain the ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) API to retrieve it.

description.zh:
子设备ID列表。可调用[QueryDevice](~~69905~~)接口查询子设备ID。

> 单次调用最多可填写20个子设备ID。
description.en:
A list of sub-device IDs. You can call the [QueryDevice](~~69905~~) API to query sub-device IDs.

> A maximum of 20 sub-device IDs can be specified in a single invocation.

description.zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
description.en: The instance ID. Do not pass this parameter for public instances; required for Enterprise instances.

title.zh: 批量关联驱动通道到子设备
title.en: Batch Associate Driver Channels with Sub-devices

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。

> RAM用户共享主账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Conditions
Each Alibaba Cloud account can make a maximum of 5 queries per second (QPS) to this API.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
